items.t: A 9.37% Dividend Yield Gift From Annaly Capital (Rating Upgrade)
items.sum: Annaly Capital Management's NLY-F preferred shares, NLY.PR.F, have finally entered our buy range, trading at $25.45 against a $25.50 buy threshold. More on it inside.

items.t: Annaly Yields Nearly 17%. These 3 High-Yield Stocks Raise Dividend Safety Concerns
items.sum: A payout that looks like a paycheck can quietly drain the company writing it. Three popular dividend payers are handing shareholders more than their businesses earn, and the gap has to come from somewhere. Find out where, and what to watch.

items.t: Annaly Capital: Fairly Valued, But A Dividend Cut In 2027 Wouldn't Surprise Me
items.sum: Analyst rates Annaly Capital Management a Hold at 1x book value; 0.9x would be more tempting, as a 2027 dividend cut remains possible.

items.t: Annaly: You Get Paid 17% To Wait For A Fed Pivot
items.sum: Annaly (NLY) stock is a buy, as its 17% dividend yield is 107% covered by EAD, and shares trade at 0.98x book value as investors wait for a rate pivot.
